Sorting yields T_s>=s q/d; bounding the resulting piecewise-linear distance over 0<=q<=1+lambda proves sufficiency at equality for all dimensions and ranks. Explicit compactness gives attainment. value.rationale: The (s-1)-skeleton is a canonical natural face filtration for the regular cross-polytope; the exact relative convexification index for every rank is a motivated unsupplied numerical invariant in current finite-convexification theory. The two distinct sharp obstruction mechanisms and plateau for all ranks s>=ceil(d/2) identify a structural transition, rather than an isolated numerical value. The all-(d,s)-classification is affine invariant and supplies benchmarks for polytope and sparse-approximation covering questions.
